limitation: Three paired related histories share twelve exact M10 founder references. Retention-first versus explicit behavioral exploration survival/breeding allocation; common all-block mutation, rotating fresh training and frozen M11 retention banks inform both arms. Survival and parent allocation are a policy package, not separately identified causal effects. Banks are reference-conditioned, not unbiased benchmarks. Equal nominal queries, not equal CPU; M11 construction is prior additional cost. Familiar grammars; no general-solving or speed claim. Exact M14 generation-64 continuation: arms already differ at entry. This extends their matched histories, not a fresh randomization. Original IDs/RNG and cumulative depths preserved; phase mutation counts and entry comparisons distinguish inheritance. No inference that more time caused a gain without a matched no-continuation comparison on these cases.

policy_comparison.limitation: Three paired histories, descriptive pilot rule; no significance or general-solver claim. No final-data role switching.
